description: This file defines a utility class 'Path' within the ScssPhp project, providing static methods to determine if a path is absolute and to join two path segments. It is part of an internal namespace used by the SCSS PHP compiler.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for path-related operations such as checking if a path is absolute and joining path segments.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines whether the given path string is an absolute path based on its syntax and platform-specific rules.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins two path segments into a single path, handling separators appropriately.
